newsitem.title: USA: Ultrak backs Q1 analysts' earnings estimate.
newsitem.headline: Ultrak backs Q1 analysts' earnings estimate.

text.p: Ultrak Inc said Wednesday that it is "comfortable" with anlysts' estimates of earnings of $0.21 per share for the first quarter of 1997, which ends in June.

Separately, the company said that it has completed the acquisition of Monitor Dynamics Inc, a maker of high-end security and access control systems. Monitor is expected to have sales of $12 million and pretax earnings of $3.5 million when its fiscal year ends on March 31, said the company.
Ultrak makes closed-circuit television and related products for use in security, surveillance and other applications.
